title: Call Tree Walkthrough
description: Loading a log, reading the color-coded call tree (green/amber/red by duration), and jumping between matched ENTER/EXIT pairs.

title: Search, Filter & Tree Search
description: Using Find, the multi-criteria Filter dialog (method name, time range, duration threshold), and the tree search box's icon/clear button/suggestions dropdown.

title: Compare Logs Side by Side
description: Diffing two log files: colour-coded trees, Structural Differences, and the Performance Delta tab.

title: Performance Tab Deep Dive
description: Top Slowest Calls, Most Frequently Called, and Call Depth Analysis, with cross-navigation back to the Call Tree.

title: Timeline & Flame Graph
description: Switching between Timeline (Gantt-style) and Flame Graph modes in the merged tab, including zoom and click-to-select.

title: Heatmap: API Activity Over Time
description: Reading the API-vs-time-bucket heatmap, toggling Count vs Time colour mode, and clicking a cell to jump to the API Tree.

title: AI Assistant: Summarize & Ask Questions
description: Using the analysis buttons (Summarize, Root Cause, Find Errors) and the free-form chat, including how Sample Response vs. real AI analysis is labelled.

title: Opening a UWGM Logging Session
description: File > Open UWGM Logging Session end to end: the folder picker, the found-files confirmation, and the resulting Log / UWGM Client / CAD Loader tabs.

title: Anomalies: Comparing Against a Baseline
description: Setting a baseline log (Options > Set as Baseline Log) and reading the Anomalies tab's flagged regressions on a later run.

title: Checking for Updates
description: Help > Check for Updates, the Update Available dialog, and a portable-zip update applying in place.
